items.content:
Howdy folks, Arno here! In today’s devlog, you’ll see what we’re currently working on, what’s coming in the next update, and more details on how we’re getting there!

⚠️ Everything below is WORK IN PROGRESS and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now! ⚠️

👻 THE SPOOKYFICATION

We have robots, we have skeletons, we have magic, we have close close east. We feel like there’s still something missing in the overall mood, and it’s THE SPOOK. While we are not going to make the game completely spooky and Halloween-esque all the time, we think that increasing the spookiness by ~20% will help the different maps feel more alive and interesting to go through. This means that all atmospheres will go through a lil’ bit of spookyfication that will remain after Halloween has passed!

Over the top paintover concept for Canyon by @Capp

Way over the top paintover concept for Woodlands by @Capp

Part of the reference board by @Capp

Also, we’ve been loving Halloween for a long time, so I’m going to shamelessly self-plug our first game Pumpkin Jack, which is available right here:

(IT’S 88% OFF RIGHT NOW! If you’re reading this devlog later on, don’t buy it at full price! The game is on sale almost all the time 🙈)

🎃 THE REDWOOD SPOOKYFICATION

A giant forest, tall trees and climbable platforms? Sure. But for now, it’s gonna be a spooky giant forest, with spooky tall trees and spooky climbable platforms 👻

Once the Halloween event is over, pumpkins will vanish from this map

Level Design & Level Art by @Borealis, atmosphere by @Spinker

👢 BANGER SKINS INCOMING

Two new ladies are here to rock the battlefield! One is covered in actually not-useful armor, the other in completely inadequate but very stylish clothing. Choose your fighter wisely!

More skins will come specifically for our Halloween event, but we haven’t worked on them yet. Maybe in the next devlog? 👻

Concept and 3D model by @MashArt, polished and rigged by @Adri

WIP Idle animation by @Calu

Original idea by @EarlGoupil (community), 3D model by @Capp, rigged by @Adri, animated by @Calu

🔫 WEAPON SKINS THAT GIVE YOU A RUN FOR YOUR MONEY

You’ve been waiting to spend your blueprints and gold for quite some time now, and you’ve been waiting for weapon skins just as long. I’m happy to announce that we’ve started working hard on them! At the moment, our artists @Capp and @MashArt are exploring different themes to see what works best in the game. More news on this in the weeks leading up to the feature being ready!

Concepts and 3D model by @MashArt

Concept and 3D model by @Capp

🎯 GAME DESIGN, EVERYWHERE, ALL AT ONCE

Before any feature or content appears in the game, it needs to be designed. As planned in our PUBLIC ROADMAP, work has started on our Halloween event, new objectives, ways to (fairly) increase the difficulty of the game, and weekly jokers. I’m also happy to announce that @Jonathan is joining our crew starting this week, and is already handling the rework of our Cryptic bosses before getting his hands on the new Zurker bosses!

WIP game design ideas by @Jonathan, not showing much as it’s very early!

Game design for the upcoming update by @me, can’t show much yet...

you didn’t see anything

🗑️ THE CRASHES ARE HAUNTING US, WE’RE HUNTING THEM BACK!

In the last devlog DEVLOG EARLY-JULY 2026, I mentioned that @Teeto was joining us for everything tech-related. Among many things, he set us up with Sentry, a very useful tool that gives us detailed logs to identify exactly what goes wrong when you crash. In only a few days, 3 of the 5 main causes of crashes have been FIXED! We are hard at work fixing the game, bug by bug, even the most troublesome ones!

Of course, all the data we receive is anonymous, and we only get the crash logs.

Tool setup by @Teeto

Random disconnections are also extremely annoying to run into as a player, especially when they make you lose a lot of progress. Just like for crashes, Sentry receives logs when a player gets disconnected, and it has already helped us fix the main cause of disconnects!

Tool setup by @Teeto

🐛 THE BUGS, THE BUGS!

You’ve been reporting MANY bugs since the Frostburn update dropped, and we’ve been reading every single one of them. For context, here are the statistics we released earlier this week:

Image by @me, like it please

Even more bugs have been reported since, and I’m happy to say that almost all of them have been fixed by @Spinker and @Mylan! Of course, since game development is that easy, fixing bugs makes other bugs happen, so the hunt never ends. Still, we’re committed to KILLING THEM ALL!

🖥️ OPTIMIZATION! WE ALL LOVE OPTIMIZATION!

We’ve been committed from the start to optimizing Far Far West as much as we could, to make sure it runs smoothly on as many computers as possible, and we constantly look for new ways to make the game run better. We’ve all heard the criticism about optimization on Unreal Engine 5, and that motivates us even more to make Far Far West a game that proves it can be done! If you’re nerdy enough to dig into the technical side of things, I’m leaving you with two videos from experts on the subject that helped us find new ways to optimize, on top of @Spinker’s own work!

We’re also dedicated to making the game run well on more unusual setups, through workarounds and different launch options (support for Vulkan SM5 incoming!)

👋 SEE YOU LATER!

There are also some improvements to a few visuals, some balancing for the upcoming patch, and a few things that aren’t quite ready to be shown yet, but no worries, they’re coming soon! 🤠

THANK YOU for playing Far Far West and sticking with us <3

See you in the next one.

Far Far West launches Frostburn, expanding gameplay with new content
items.summary: Far Far West has officially launched Frostburn, a major update adding new gameplay, a new map, build systems, and over 100 bug fixes.
items.content:
Far Far West has officially released Frostburn, the first major update since the game launched. Version 0.2.0.2 not only adds new content but also significantly expands how players approach each run, with a large number of new weapons, a new map, and major changes to the character progression system. Frostburn also comes with over 100 bug fixes, along with numerous improvements to balance, AI, and the overall experience.

Frostburn primarily focuses on expanding the gameplay of Far Far West . One of the biggest additions is the introduction of melee weapons, giving players a new way to play alongside the existing ranged weapons. Knuckles, Lasso, and Banjo each offer a different playstyle and are supported by new upgrades and Jokers, giving players more options when building their setups.

To support melee combat, the update also introduces Shield Points, a new defensive layer that absorbs damage before it affects HP. The system works directly with various weapons, Jokers, and Frost spells, encouraging players to experiment with builds focused on defense or getting up close to enemies.

The Frost Element is another major addition in Frostburn. This new element allows players to freeze enemies and generate Shield Points, while also introducing several spells designed for offense, defense, and team support. The combination of Frost, Shield, and melee gives Far Far West an entirely new gameplay direction to explore. The update also expands the exploration side of the game. Hellfire is a new map set in a dangerous volcanic environment, complete with its own quests and secrets. Jungle has also received additional quests and a new secret. The new Lighthouse system makes it easier for players to discover special locations scattered across the map.

On the progression side, Item Fragments have been replaced by Blueprints, while Uranium has been introduced as a new resource used during missions. These changes are designed to simplify the process of unlocking weapons and give activities during missions a clearer purpose.

Frostburn also adds a large number of new Jokers and adjusts many existing ones, expanding the possibilities for building characters and weapons. The developers say these changes are aimed at creating more playstyles while reducing reliance on certain overly powerful options. Alongside the new content, Frostburn brings a major balance pass covering weapons, spells, Jokers, upgrades, and enemies. The AI system has also been partially rewritten to improve enemy behavior and reduce CPU usage. More than 100 bugs have been fixed, along with various improvements to the UI, visual effects, audio, and overall stability.

Frostburn is therefore more than just a content update, marking the first major expansion of Far Far West since launch. The development team has also published a roadmap and says it plans to share more regular updates on the game's development going forward, suggesting that these changes are only part of its long-term plans. With Frostburn now officially available, this is also a good time for returning players to discover the new playstyles, while newcomers have even more reasons to step into the world of Far Far West . The game is currently available at 20% off for two weeks to celebrate the update.

Far Far West is a chaotic co-op shooter that puts a wild spin on the Wild West. Instead of classic gunslingers, players step into the metal bodies of robot cowboys who carry out bounty missions for the local sheriff. The game only entered Early Access in April 2026, which the developers say is expected to last around 12 months. The Wild West shooter is currently celebrating its first 20% discount on Steam, bringing the regular price down from around $20 to $16 .

In terms of gameplay, Far Far West focuses on fast-paced PvE combat – but not just with revolvers and shotguns, as magic also plays a major role. Players can dash and jump, combine spells and customize their playstyle through weapons and perks. There are no fixed classes: Players can specialize in headshots, high spell damage or healing, for example. Between missions, weapons, spells and abilities can be upgraded in town. A robotic horse is also available for getting around the larger maps. More details on the gameplay can be found in our Far Far West launch article .

ⓘ Fireshine Games Pictured: A gameplay screenshot from Far Far West. ⓘ Fireshine Games Pictured: A gameplay screenshot from Far Far West. German gaming magazine Gamereactor tested the Wild West shooter and particularly praised the fast and precise gunplay as well as the numerous ways to combine weapons, spells and perks into custom builds. In addition to some technical issues, criticism was mainly directed at the progression, which reportedly becomes increasingly sluggish as the game goes on. Overall, however, the game still earned 8 out of 10 points. Steam players also seem to be enjoying the game: 95% of the more than 36,000 reviews are positive. The game is also Steam Deck Verified, making the current discount an interesting offer for shooter fans overall.

items.content:
Howdy y’all! 

Frostburn is officially out now!

Before we get into everything that’s packed into this update, we wanted to quickly follow up on something we mentioned in our last post.

We know it’s been a little quiet from us for a while, and we said we’d start opening the curtains a bit more on what’s happening behind the scenes. The truth is, the last few months absolutely knocked us sideways. The release was a huge moment for our small team, and after everything that came with it, we needed some time to rest and recover. From here on out, we’ll be sharing more regular progress updates and dev blogs, so you can follow along with how Far Far West is coming together.

We’ve also put together a roadmap for Far Far West, giving you a rough idea of what we’re planning to add to the game and when you can expect to see it. Obviously, things can change at any time as development continues, but we wanted to give you a better idea of where we’re heading.

-> ROADMAP <-

FFW ON DISCOUNT!

ALSO! For the next TWO WEEKS Far Far West will be discounted by 20%! So if you or your pals have been waiting for some new content or a sweet discount to ride into the west, FROSTBURN is for y’all!

(Discount asset?)

Alright, enough talk. Let’s get into the…

FROSTBURN UPDATE!

DISCLAIMER!!

Last final small disclaimer:

There have been some issues with AMD Frame Generation across multiple titles. If you encounter any kind of performance issues or crashes, please make sure to try turning AMD FSR ON or OFF. AMD is looking to release a patch to resolve this issue soon, so please bear with us! <3

FEATURES/CONTENT

⚔️ITEM FRAGMENTS 

The way item fragments worked was complicated, and not many people understood it until they had a few games under their belt. It was also a big hassle to remember to start tracking another item every time you were done with one. This new system simplifies everything by making them a universal currency.

  • Item Fragments are now called Blueprints

    [/*]

  • Tracking items to earn their blueprints is gone. You now collect blueprints during missions like you do any currency, and can then use them at the lobby

    [/*]

  • You no longer need to pay gold to buy a weapon after unlocking it. Spending blueprints to unlock them will directly purchase them

    [/*]

  • 🚨 All your accumulated blueprints on each weapon have been aggregated and converted to the unique blueprint currency 🚨

    [/*]

🚨 LIGHTHOUSES 

We figured that most of the time, people almost never stumbled upon the Copy Press, the Refiner, or any other unique location, even though they did spawn in the mission. The main way to find them was to recognize their shape on the mini-map. Well, we’re adding a proper way of discovering what spawned on your map through lighthouses!

  • Lighthouses spawn in every mission and are indicated on your mini-map

    [/*]

  • Reaching the top of a lighthouse (we know you’ll use spells to cheat your way up) and completing its minigame reveals the map and its unique locations

    [/*]

☢️ URANIUM

You previously had to spend Gold to buy, copy or refine jokers during your games, which was annoying since Gold is also the money used to unlock long-term things in the lobby. We’re adding a new currency that only exists in-mission, so that using the tools available in-game never feels like a waste anymore. You also earn Uranium by completing quests & secrets, making sure replaying either of those is never useless. Finally, as the joker list keeps expanding, so does the chance of stumbling upon jokers you don’t like. You’ll now be able to break those jokers and get Uranium instead, then spend it on whatever you want.

  • Anything that costs currency during a mission now uses Uranium instead of Gold

    [/*]

  • Leftover Uranium at the end of a mission is converted into XP for your hero and your weapons

    [/*]

  • Uranium can be collected in different ways:

    • Break a Joker \[NEW: hit a Joker with your fists to break it]

      • The amount of Uranium depends on the rarity of the broken joker

        [/*]

      • Dropped jokers do not give Uranium

        [/*]
      [/*]

    • Kill an Elite enemy

      [/*]

    • Complete a secondary objective

      [/*]

    • Complete a quest

      [/*]

    • Complete a secret

      [/*]

    • Complete a lighthouse

      [/*]

      [/*]

    • Flying balloons

      [/*]

🥊 MELEE WEAPONS

MELEE WEAPOOOOOOOOOOONS! You’ve asked for them A LOT, and here they are! Melee weapons bring a new way of playing Far Far West, each with its own playstyle, just like the ranged weapons. They don’t use a dedicated slot and will replace either your primary or your secondary weapon, so make sure you can still kill every enemy with your setup before going into missions! This is only the first batch of melee weapons, more will come along the way :)

PRIMARY SLOT MELEE WEAPONS:

  • Knuckles: Short range, big impact. Requires no ammo, no aim, and no thoughts.

Lasso: Whips enemies fast at a decent reach. Some of them come back for more, and not out of spite.

📈 UPGRADES

items.content:
Korean (한국어) Add us on ©Evil Raptor, Fireshine Games Evil Raptor and Fireshine Games announced on August 27 that they have launched 'Frostburn,' a major update for the co-op PvE shooter 'Far Far West,' on PC via Steam.

'Far Far West' is a 1–4 player co-op shooter set in a Western world where guns and magic collide. Players explore various regions, battle enemies, and complete quests while combining weapons and 'Jokers' to customize their combat style.

This update adds 'Hellfire,' a new lava and volcano-themed region. Meteors periodically fall during gameplay while the central volcano erupts, accompanied by three new quests and one hidden element.

A new Ice element and Shield system have also been introduced. The shield absorbs incoming enemy attacks via a separate gauge and fades over time. Depending on the combination of Ice magic and Jokers, the shield can be utilized for offensive play or recovery.

There are five new Ice spells: 'Cube,' which turns oneself or an ally into a block of ice; 'Ice Lance,' which creates an ice path; 'Breeze,' which freezes enemies in front; 'Glaze,' which consumes shields to deal damage to nearby enemies; and 'Blizzard,' which attacks enemies within range while providing shields to allies.

New melee weapons include 'Knuckle Dusters,' 'Lasso,' and 'Banjo.' All three weapons support upgrades and customization, with each having its own dedicated Joker. Among them, the Banjo allows players to build charges through attacks and restore health for themselves and nearby allies.

A 'Lighthouse' system that aids exploration has also been introduced. Once players complete a Lighthouse platforming puzzle, key points of interest in the region are marked on the map. Three new quests and one hidden element have also been added to the existing Jungle region, along with new player skins and Jokers.

items.content:
Howdy, y’all!

We know it’s been a while.

We’ve seen the comments, the questions, the “when update?” messages. We know you’ve been waiting, and we really appreciate y’all sticking with us

The honest answer is that a lot has been happening behind the scenes

We’re a small indie team, and when we launched Far Far West into the world, we definitely didn’t expect the level of love and success that came our way. It’s been AMAZING!! But it’s also meant taking a step back and making sure we were ready for what comes next.

Over the last few months, we’ve been doing a lot of work that isn’t particularly exciting to show in a trailer, reworking internal structures, expanding the team, improving how we work, and figuring out what the future of Far Far West should actually look like.

We’ve been taking our time with this because we want to hold ourselves to the same standards we’ve always had for the game. We don’t just want to throw updates out the door for the sake of having something to show.

And now, we’re ready to start showing you what we’ve been working on.

Introducing the FROSTBURN UPDATE!

On August 27th, our next major update for FFW arrives

Full details on the update will be available on launch day! For now put your guesses for the update in the comments 

Play Frostburn First at Gamescom

If you’re heading to Gamescom, you’ll actually be able to get your hands on Frostburn a full 24 HOURS before anyone else.

🗓️26th August, 1PM (CET) | Booth 131, Hall 10.2

Come say hi, play the new update, let us know what you think and grab your very own FFW cowboy hat (while stocks last). We can’t wait to meet y’all!

Thanks again for hanging around while we’ve been busy behind the scenes. We know the wait hasn’t been the most fun, but we think you’ll understand why we took the time once you start seeing what we’ve been working towards.

The dust is starting to settle. Frostburn is coming.

See y’all in the Far (Far) West

- The Far Far West Team 🤠🌵

Don’t forget to follow our socials

Join our Discord

And review FFW on Steam (maybe after the new update)

items.content:
🔥 THIS SUMMER, WE’RE COOKING 🔥

(It’s really hot outside..)

Howdy y'all!

Welcome to a big catch-up devlog covering most of what the team has cooked up between the last update and early July 👽

So, what’s been happening behind the curtain? Let’s take a look!

Keep in mind that everything below is WORK IN PROGRESS and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now!

The Zurkers keep crawling out of the spaceship

Our new sci-fi invader faction, the Zurkers, keeps on growing! Their faces are a bit glitchy for now, since we still haven’t managed to get them to sign a release form for their image rights.

(Actually, we’re still in the early stages of the army and have a LOT of work to do before showing anything too detailed to you all.)

Concepts & 3D models by @Capp and @MashArt / Textures and rigs by @Adrian

New exploration POIs: Lighthouses

A new family of Lighthouse points of interest is now scattered across the maps. If you’re careful enough with your jumps, you’ll learn a lot more about your surroundings!

Instead of getting the Anvil, Refiner, and Copy Press revealed for free on the minimap, you’ll now have to climb lighthouses and water towers, then play a minigame to reveal the whole map! The idea is to reward decision-making, not pure luck. You can still stumble onto any hidden structure by exploring on foot, but a lighthouse will light your way with ease.

This feature is still WIP and needs some balancing and polish (sounds, VFX)

Level Design by @Promium / Level Art by @Erton

The Jungle map needs some explorers!

Mysterious places have been spotted deep in the Jungle… A questline has been added! Explore 3 underground dungeons and collect all the ancient scrolls to unlock the brand-new Hellfire map!

There’s also a secret, but since it’s a secret, I can’t tell you there’s one.

Level Design by @Promium / Level Art by @Erton

The Hellfire map

The Hellfire map is almost done, and it’s already crawling with Cryptics waiting to ambush you.

Level Design & Level Art by @Erton

The Redwood Forest map

Work has started on a brand-new map: a giant redwood forest. Think towering trees wrapped in climbable wooden platforms, with vertical paths to fight your way through. Very early days for now!

Level Design & Level Art by @Erton

Melee weapons… are COMING!

It’s time to get up close and personal, don’t you think?

A whole rack of melee weapons is cooking! We’re still working out exactly how they’ll play and how to balance them with the rest of the game, which is why there’s not much footage to show just yet!

Concepts & 3D models by @Capp and @MashArt / Textures and rigs by @Adrian

Skins? SKIIIIIIIIIINS!

The art team has also whipped up some fresh skins!

Original fanart by community member @Swolf, reworked and modeled by @Capp - The Aviator

Concept & 3D model by @MashArt - Bullet Bob! The new weapon smith!

Concept & 3D model by @Capp - Arizona Jones, the Jungle quest NPC!

Rig by @Adrian

A new element? Definitely. A most-requested one? For sure.

I’ll just leave you with a screenshot that should be more than enough of a visual clue to guess what it is.

And since I love to cultivate mystery, I’m sending this one along too. (It’s a shield.) (This is no longer a mystery.) (The shield mechanic is coming.)

Jokers. More Jokers. And after that, even more Jokers.

We’re adding some quality-of-life improvements to Jokers! We’re also cooking up a LOT (30+) of new Jokers, some designed specifically to make melee builds viable. It’s a first step toward our bigger goal of diversifying builds!

Two new members on the team!

We’ve had two fresh faces join the crew recently!

PROmium is here to handle a whole bunch of level design and programming stuff, from quests to enemies and more. The man fears nothing.

Teeto will handle everything tech-related, meaning more programming stuff, but not the same kind of programming stuff. There are a lot of different kinds of programming stuff, you know. He’s currently working on our network, a Discord integration, a Twitch integration, and a lot more internal tools to make our lives at Evil Raptor easier!

Thanks for readin'

There’s still plenty we’re working on that didn’t make it into this devlog, but for now, that’s it for this peek behind the curtain! Again, all of this is WIP, no gameplay, and some of it might change a lot or never ship

THANK YOU for playing Far Far West and sticking with us <3

See you in the next one.

Howdy everyone! We missed a few things in today's patch, so we're quickly fixing it with this hot-hotfix:

  • Removed the dash icon next to the HP bar

    [/*]

🔽 Minigun accuracy lowered by -30%.

The Minigun was as precise as a Long Ranger, which does not make sense with how quickly you can shoot its powerful bullets. This slight nerf should make it more in line with other weapons.

🔄 Speedster now gives up to +55% damage and firerate at a 110% bonus movespeed cap.

By fixing a joker, we broke Speedster a little bit. Good thing, it was already broken from a previous patch and did not have the intended values. However, most people have gotten used to how it works now, so we're keeping the values you've mostly played with. Good for you, it's more than what we intended at the start. Enjoy 🙂

We overdid the Homing Burst Joker nerf... So we're offsetting with a small buff!

    [/*]

items.content:
Howdy everyone!!

We're back with another small patch for y'all,

PATCH 0.1.1.10

As always, we read and listen to your feedback on our changes! If we added or modified something that the community disagrees with, then it will most likely be changed in a later update! The game is in constant evolution, and nothing is set in stone, so do not hesitate to give feedback about anything related to the patch once you’ve tried it out!

VISUAL

New Lobby look for this summer!

Beware of the vultures…

BALANCE

WEAPONS

🔼 Quad Cylinder

Quad Cylinder still didn’t find its own place with the buffs from version 0.1.1.3, so we’re going all-in to make sure it provides a more reliable and enjoyable experience.

  • Improved hipfire and ADS accuracy by 90% (based on the new accuracy from patch 0.1.1.3, so this is a big increase!)

    [/*]

  • Reduced recoil during ADS by 50%

    [/*]

  • Base ammo from 192 to 216

    [/*]

  • Base damage from 8 to 9

    [/*]

  • Accuracy upgrade is now available on the weapon

    [/*]

JOKERS

🔼 Pigshot

  • Pig HP has been reduced from 100HP to 50HP (this makes them easier to explode!)

    [/*]

🔼 Shroom Grave

  • Mushrooms restore 30HP instead of 20HP

    [/*]

🔼 Run & Reload

  • Now give +50% move speed instead of +30%

    [/*]

🔁 Anti-Gravity Falls

  • Now activates anti-gravity only if you dash or jump within the zone

    [/*]

🔼 Magic Friendship

  • Area of effect increased from 15 meters to 20 meters

    [/*]

🔼 Destroyer

  • Max equippable increased from 1 to 2

    [/*]

🔼 Hit Me

  • HP restored has been increased from 0.5HP/sec. to 0.75HP/sec.

    [/*]

🔼 Mark Ace

  • Buff duration has been increased from 3 sec. to 5 sec.

    [/*]

🔼 Chonky Throw

  • The boomerang is twice as big > The boomerang is twice as big and goes through shields

    [/*]

🔁 Rampage

The current iteration of Rampage doesn’t have a spot in any build, as Run & Gun is just a better and more reliable version of it. We’re changing it so it has its own usefulness, rewarding the player for constantly fighting

  • Killing an enemy grants 25% movespeed for 3 seconds (no stacking) > Gain 5% reload speed on kill for 10 seconds, up to 100%

    • Rarity increased from Fine to Prime

      [/*]

    • An icon has been added near the HP bar to display your current buff amount

      [/*]
    [/*]

🔼 Mindshot

This reduces the amount of explosions you will proc, but explosions are now 3x stronger and 2x wider, making it actually useful at clearing multiple enemies at once

  • Your weakspot hits cause an explosion > Weakspot hits have 50% chance to cause an explosion

    [/*]

Quad Cylinder accuracy has been greatly buffed, meaning your shots have way more chance of hitting where you aim, rendering the current iteration of Aiming Burst useless. This new version makes it so that this unique Joker is constantly good and rewards the player for aiming well

Our recent change on Homing Burst has led to some… unexpected results that are way, way too overpowered compared to all other weapons. This wouldn’t be an issue if getting that much power relied on the player's skill, but this iteration works by itself without even really aiming.

🔁 Aiming Burst

  • While aiming, your shots have perfect accuracy, and you are not slowed down > +30% weakspot damage and piercing bullets while ADS

    [/*]

🔽 Homing Burst

  • The first and last shot of your magazine fires 5 homing bullets > Every 6 bullets fired, shoot 1 homing bullet at nearby enemies

    [/*]

SPELLS

🔼 Finger Guns

  • Shoots 17% faster, and projectiles are no longer affected by gravity

    [/*]

ENEMIES

Some of our enemy balance additions from patch 0.1.1.3 are a bit too strong, so we’re lowering some of our Cryptic friends’ efficiency! (and bees)

🔽 Bees

  • Attack duration lowered from 8 sec. to 6 sec.

    [/*]

  • Base damages reduced from 4 to 2

    [/*]

🔽 Cryptic Slinger

  • \ Damage has been lowered by 33%

    [/*]

  • \ Projectile speed has been lowered by 25%

    [/*]

🔽 Cryptic Elites

  • Lowered HP by 20%

    [/*]

🔼 Cryptic Horseman

  • Buffed HP to match Elites HP

    [/*]

PROGRESSION

🔼 XP Tickets

  • Now give +5 levels instead of +3 levels

    [/*]

BUG FIXES

Very minor bugfixes and tweaks are not listed

Fixed +15 bugs, including:

  • Fixed an unintended interaction that allowed a player to cancel their reload via a weapon inspect animation

    [/*]

  • Fixed the issue that would cause a Deathrattle to prevent navigation within the Wandering Trader or Refiner menus

    [/*]

  • Fixed the issue that wouldn’t let you do 2 quests in a single mission if they came from different NPCs

    [/*]

  • Fixed the issue that would leave the mouse on screen after you’ve held right click while using the emote wheel

    [/*]

  • Cryptic Train now properly rewards XP for weapons when you hit it

    [/*]

  • Bow explosions XP is now calculated client-side, improving its reliability

    [/*]

  • Battlecries are no longer replayed in a loop during the tutorial

    [/*]

  • Joker Second Wind: now properly triggers when the player dies while riding the horse

    [/*]

MISC

  • Jokers that can’t be dropped are now marked as such before you collect them

    [/*]

  • Reworked flash screen effects (dash, heal, shooting bullet)

    [/*]

  • Joker Life Pact can now be dropped

    [/*]

  • Joker Soul Eater: refined description to make it clearer

    [/*]

Thanks for readin'! See y'all next time.
